name: Analytics query
func:
msg.topic = `
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT slot, status, timestamp,
           LEAD(status)    OVER (PARTITION BY slot ORDER BY id) AS next_status,
           LEAD(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY slot ORDER BY id) AS next_time,
           boot_id,
           LEAD(boot_id)   OVER (PARTITION BY slot ORDER BY id) AS next_boot
    FROM parking_logs
),
durations AS (
    SELECT slot, AVG((julianday(next_time) - julianday(timestamp)) * 1440) AS avg_min
    FROM ordered
    WHERE status = 'OCCUPIED' AND next_status = 'AVAILABLE'
      -- only pair events from the same device run, so time when the
      -- system was switched off is not counted as parking time
      AND ((boot_id IS NOT NULL AND boot_id = next_boot)
           OR (boot_id IS NULL AND next_boot IS NULL
               AND (julianday(next_time) - julianday(timestamp)) * 1440 <= 120))
    GROUP BY slot
)
SELECT p.slot AS "Slot",
       SUM(p.status = 'OCCUPIED') AS "Times occupied",
       SUM(p.status = 'SENSOR_ERROR') AS "Sensor faults",
       IFNULL(ROUND(d.avg_min, 1), '-') AS "Avg stay (min)",
       (SELECT status FROM parking_logs x WHERE x.slot = p.slot ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Last logged",
       (SELECT datetime(MAX(timestamp), 'localtime') FROM parking_logs y WHERE y.slot = p.slot) AS "Last change"
FROM parking_logs p LEFT JOIN durations d ON d.slot = p.slot
GROUP BY p.slot ORDER BY p.slot;`;
msg.payload = [];
return msg;
